batting.dismissal: c JM Bairstow b Mujeeb Ur Rahman

batting.name: HH Pandya
batting.dismissal: c Virat Singh b KK Ahmed

batting.name: MK Pandey
batting.dismissal: c KA Pollard b RD Chahar

batting.name: Virat Singh
batting.dismissal: c SA Yadav b RD Chahar

batting.name: V Shankar
batting.dismissal: c SA Yadav b JJ Bumrah

batting.name: Abhishek Sharma
batting.dismissal: c AF Milne b RD Chahar

balls.text: another length ball and sent on its way! An ordinary end to Bhuvi's spell. It's length, it's outside off, it's 124kph. Pollard gets a half stride out and slogs on the rise to long-on's right
misses his length and is smoked straight. Overpitched ball outside off, uses his big reach to to get under that and swings it straight over long-on
length outside off, mistimed slog to deep midwicket's left and this time they take the throw on and make it for the second
yorker at middle stump, chopped out to sweeper over
Pollard wanted Krunal to come back for the second but he's sent back. Length outside off, looks to slog and ends up dragging it wide of deep midwicket off the inside edge.
length and wide outside off, looks to slap it on the rise, gets an under-edge towards the keeper
offcutter at a length, coming in at the stumps from outside off. Watchfully steered towards short third
short of a length offcutter at off stump, jabbed to point's right off the back foot

taken running in from sweeper. This is a smart grab. Another slower ball, cutting away from the right-hander outside off. Pandya looks to force that straight off the back foot and ends up slicing it. Virat Singh the debutant keeps his eyes on it and calls so that extra cover running backwards gets out of his way. Tracks it nicely and completes the catch with his balance intact

dropped at deep midwicket! Shankar puts down a sitter. It's an offcutter at a length on middle stump. Pollard swishes it one-handed with his left-hand into the leg side, Shankar is already under that but offered hard hands. That pops right out
beaten. Another cutter at a length, slow and just climbing over off stump as he swings across the line of this
outside edge just past Bairstow's right hand. It's an offcutter at length outside off, Pollard swings across the line and isn't in control of that
length at off stump, looks to drill down the ground and gets it off the thick inside edge to long-on's right

he can't gather that at the non-strikers and that's at least a half-chance gone for SRH. Short of a length ball punched firmly to Warner's left at long-off. His once-bounce throw is a bit loopy and gets big on Bhuvi. Hardik would have been in trouble if Warner had marginally more time
yorker just outside off, jammed into the covers with an open face
short and wide outside off, punched firmly to long-off's left and Warner sprints and slides to keep that to two

swished past short third but I'm not sure he was in control of that. It's a legcutter, rising from a length outside off. He looks to run that past point and closes the face to try and keep it down. It comes off the back of the bat and sails fine of the short third fielder
short of a length and staying low outside, walks down at that and chops to sweeper
good length and spun rapidly into the front pad as he plants the front foot out and looks to flick
short of a length and down leg side, beaten on the glance

taken down leg side. Kishan's misery ends. Just didn't get going today. A carrom ball, short of a length and sliding down leg side. Kishan gets on a knee and looks to swing that behind square. Gets a thin edge, or a glove on that, and Bairstow does brilliantly to grab that down leg to his right
beaten. Googly, short of a length and wide outside off from around the wicket. Looks to slap that over extra cover and misses
googly, short of a length on middle stump. Punched to deep midwicket off the back foot
ripped into the pads with a googly. On a length, coming in sharply as he misses on the place
sent a long way over deep midwicket! That is massive. 105 metres, says broadcast! Is that nerves from Mujeeb? Drops it very short at off stump and Pollard has so much time to send this into orbit
full googly at middle stump, nearly loses balance trying to reach out for this. Didn't pick it at all. Clips the outside of his left pad and runs fine of short fine
short of a length googly, spun down leg side. Can't get bat on it
appeal for lbw is turned down. Pollard didn't pick that googly, was very deep in the crease and caught in front of middle and leg playing the off stump line. That spin too much, going down
googly at a length on middle stump, leans in and jabs through cover
full legrbreak outside leg, looks to flick and is beaten on the inside edge. Catches it on the pads
googly, short and turning away from off. Pulled to long-on's left
dropped short at an off stump line, through the pull very early. Inside edge onto front pad
full offcutter outside off, walks into that and swishes in front of the body again. Thick outside edge through cover
beats the outside edge with a cutter. Length ball dug in just outside off, turns and rises as Pollard feels for it in front of the body
good length outside off, leans in and punches to extra cover
short of a length and across the corridor, drops the arms and lets that go
short of a length and cramping him in the corridor as he shuffles to try and cut, check punched off the back foot to sweeper

nearly run out first ball! Good length just outside off, nice stride as he pats this to Warner's right at mid-off. He swoops down and gets a side-arm throw as he leaps but he can't hit the stumps at the non-strikers
full offbreak at off stump, driven straight back to the bowler

holes out at deep midwicket. This was coming from QDK, he hasn't been able to find too many boundaries. He steps down leg side, Mujeeb follows him with a slow-ish length ball that spins into him. He can't get a lot of distance on the slog
length and sliding on quickly at middle stump. Whipped to deep midwicket's left
short of a length and sliding on at the stumps, backs into the leg side and punches this to long-on
length and sliding on at off, deep in the crease and whipped to deep square
length ball outside off, driven on the rise to extra cover's left
offcutter, short of a length outside off. Slapped on the up to sweeper cover
legcutter this time, back of a length and just outside off. Shapes to slap it on the rise and can only jab it as far as extra cover
full and just outside off, toe-ended drive to long-off along the ground
check drive to long-off's left. Slower length ball and he has to adjust as he pats this over the bowler's head
dipping yorker outside off, a slower ball. Beats him on the reverse whip

looks like a drop at deep backward square. Short ball outside off, steps into the off side and swats this with the angle. It dips on Rashid running in from there and diving forward. Catches it on the wrist and then sends in a wild throw at the non-strikers end which gives them a second
short of a length, googly outside off. Jabbed into the covers off the back foot
short of a length and spun into the body, whipped to deep square
reverse swipe past short third man. Googly, short of a length and wide outside off. Onto it early and ends up getting a top edge, but it is fine of the fielder
googly, short of a length and ripping away outside off. Kishan doesn't pick that, simply feels for it away from his body. Ends up a single at long-off
short of a length, googly, outside off. Hurriedly cut to sweeper cover
googly, short and wide outside off. Dragged with a pull to deep midwicket's left
full at middle stump, driven to long-on
good length and skidding into the pads as he looks to glance that
short and wide outside off, cut to sweeper
short of a length fingerspinner, down leg side. Looks to glance, can't get bat on it
googly, short of a length outside off. Cut firmly to extra cover's right but can't beat the dive
length at middle stump, gets deep in the crease and whips to deep midwicket
googly at a length outside off, turns away and he punches it to the bowler off the back foot
short of a length googly outside off, closes the face on it and punches from Rashid's left to long-on
short of a length, legbreak at middle stump. Whipped to deep midwicket off the back foot
quicker legbreak, turning into middle stump from off stump. Hurriedly punched to deep midwicket
jumps past the leading edge! Good length, another googly at off. Not picked. Kishan leans in and tries to flick this, but that rises furiously past his back shoulder
rips massively past the outside edge. Googly, pitches off stump and ends up near the wide marker as Kishan hangs the bat out
good length on middle stump, nicely forward to push this back to the bowler
offcutter, short and wide outside off. Cut along the ground to backward point
short of a length and sliding into the body from around the wicket. Chopped to short third
inside edge to fine leg's left. Short of a length and wide delivery outside off. Looks to cut that away from the body, that doesn't quite rise

chipped straight back to the bowler. That stops on him as he settled behind it and force it to long-off. It was a length bat at off stump and didn't slide on the way he wanted to. Shankar gets it about thigh height to his right and he takes it gratefully
oh caressed over the extra cover boundary. This is a friendly ball, about 120kph, overpitched outside off. Gets half a stride out at that and lofts it inside-out
slower ball at a length outside off, chopped to sweeper
googly at a length on off stump, leans in and flicks to midwicket
short of a length just outside off, defended into the covers off the back foot
length at off stump, gets a knee down and swipes across the angle to get this past short fine
length outside off, hurried onto him and chopped into the pitch
is that a drop? Sounded like something as QDK looked to drive this googly outside off. Bairstow didn't hold onto it. Rashid was interested. We'll need some replays
short of a length slider wide outside off, under-edge on the attempted cut
length outside off, sweet drive on the up but extra cover fields to the right with a dive

mid-off tumbles over it. Low full toss outside off, looks to caress that wide of the fielder at mid-off and doesn't quite place it. Sharma gets behind it and his knee digs into the surface as he tumbles and creates a tunnel for the ball to go through
overpitched at off stump, driven back to the bowler on the bounce

hauled straight to deep midwicket! Length ball outside off at 121kph, there for the slog. Clears the front leg and looks to send this into the stands. It was in the slot but he's missed out on connection, comes off the low inside part of the bat
short of a length and sliding into off stump. Chopped past extra cover off the back foot
cross-seam length ball outside off, driven on the up to long-off
short of a length and skidding on straight outside off, punched to extra cover off the back foot
length at middle stump, steps out and clips to deep midwicket
mistimed slog to deep midwicket's left. Loopy length ball outside off and Rohit loses his shape as he gets down on a knee and reaches out at this
short of a length and holds its line at an off stump line. QDK behind it on the back foot as he tucks it through vacant midwicket
full at off stump, steps out and drives to long-off
full and lobbed up at leg stump. Gets to the pitch and drives straight to mid-on

whipped over short fine. Unreal how easily he's done this. Short of a length at off stump, he takes a step back into the off side, watches that onto his body and lifts it. Barely moved, for such a complex shot
good length and getting big on him as he leans in for a drive on the up. Dropped into the point region off the thick outside edge
beats him with the slower ball. A fingerspinner dropped in at a length, outside off. Rohit wants to lace that on the rise but it grips and bounces past the bat
eshort and wide outside off, late curve away to take it past the wide marker. Beaten on the cut
slashed past backward point. Doesn't bother keeping that down. Short and wide and across him, gets a a lot of power on the cut
short of a length and tight at off stump, punched to cover off the back foot
short of a length and rising across the corridor, along with the angle across. Beats him on the cut
length at off stump, looks to drive on the up through cover and gets an inside edge onto body that trickles past the stumps

slogged over midwicket. Oh they're coming nicely off the bat tonight for Rohit. This is a good length ball just outside off. He gets the front leg into the leg side to create swinging room and swings nicely too
good length and swung in sharply at a middle stump line. Watchfully defended down the pitch as this dips in and cramps him
short of a length at middle stump, hurried pull down to fine leg
inside edge to short fine's right. That's more like the Chennai pitch we've seen this season. Length ball wide outside off, looks to slap that through cover on the up but that skids on low and slow
good length and just outside off, blocked on the front foot
offbreak at a length on middle stump, steps out and whips to deep midwicket
attempted googly is slaughtered over square leg. He drops it short and Rohit has a lot of time to pick up this incoming delivery from off stump and swing with the line
carted over midwicket! It looks like an offbreak at a good length, wide outside off so a lot of swinging room. And he sweeps that firmly
length and skidding onto middle stump, driven to long-on with the angle
good length and turning away outside off, under-edge on the attempted square drive
offbreak, at a length and turning into leg stump. Stands tall and clips that through square leg
length and just outside off, punched on the rise to extra cover
short of a length outside off, dropped into the off side with soft hands
short of a length outside off, chopped to point
quickly past the outside edge. 141kph and sliding on rapidly with the angle as Rohit hangs the bat outside off

tickled past the keeper down leg side. Length ball at leg stump, gets low and looks to swing that behind square. Gets a thin edge onto leg and past the keeper. The umpire says leg byes...and he is right, there wasn't any bat on it as I'd mentioned
short of a length and hitting the bat hard just outside off, QDK's weight on the back foot as he opens the face and runs this down. The siren goes off. He has overstepped
one bounce to deep square. Short of a length and rising at leg stump, short-arm pull off the hips
appeal for catch behind is not reviewed. A length ball down leg side, looks to flick it and gets a pretty big deflection as YJB leaps to his right to catch two-handed. Looks it was only off the leg
misfield at extra cover and once it beats mid-off, it's away quickly. Length ball at off stump, punched to extra cover's left and Shankar can't stop on the awkward bounce
good length and cutting across to an off stump line. QDK shuffles and looks to glance. Gets it off the pad to Bairstow's right, taken with a one-handed stretch
full awayswinger from off stump. Jabs at that and gets it to midwicket off the thick inside edge
good length and at off stump. Closes the face too soon on that, gets a leading edge to point
elegantly punched past the bowler off the front foot. Full and swung in at middle stump. Quick reflexes after planting half a step across off stump, manages to get the full face on it
splits middle and off and Mumbai Indians have done it yet again. Yorker nailed once again and Mujeeb's attempted chop is futile. Boult finishes with three wickets
yorker at middle stump, looks to drive, thick outside edge straight to short third
yorker at off stump, Stays deep in the crease and squeezes it to point's right
tonks off stump! 139kph, dead-on yorker starting at middle and curving away. Bhuvi looks to club across the line but that is long past his attempt
slower ball, short of a length outside off. Shapes to cut, steers to  backward point's left. A diving stop from the fielder. Bhuvi has the strike for the last over

no, he's decided to try and pick up the boundary and sliced it straight up for long-off. This is the end of this chase, barring a serious miracle. Full slower ball outside off, reaching out in front of his body once again, trying to loft it straight. Just no control at all. Bumrah's bowled something like 9 consecutive slower balls and they've had no answers
beaten as he looks to run this to the keeper's right. A full ball outside off, looks to guide it with an open face

swung to deep square's left. Slower ball at a length outside off, shuffles outside off and swings for the turn into him. Manages to connect but it's a real scramble to come back for the second. Bumrah not happy with Boult who slowed as he got behind that and couldn't get the throw in
slower ball at a length, wide outside off. Reaches out and swipes across the line. Can't make connection
low full toss just outside off, steps into the off side and jabs it past extra cover. An easy two to sweeper's right

he's been given lbw and he reviews. It's a searing yorker that's caught him dead in front of middle and off. But did it catch the toe of the bat or his actual toe? Looks like the latter...right toe. Nothing on Ultra Edge as that passes the bat and tracking will confirm that this is plumb. Brilliant, brilliant yorker from Boult. The option to play Bumrah out has been snatched by the two wickets he's taken in this over
yorker at leg stump, stabbed towards deep midwicket and an immediate call for two. No chance as the fielder sprints in

got him! Hardik Pandya has nailed another direct hit. This time at the non-strikers end. Yorker length ball outside off, jams it to extra cover's right and is deep in the crease when he does it. Has to gather his bearings as he takes off. Hardik swoops down one with his right hand and hits it stumps on the half-volley. Don't think Samad would have had a chance even if he'd had any momentum at the start of the run
nicely placed! Waits on this slow short ball outside off, shuffles into line, adjusts for the pace and pulls firmly into the floor to bisect deep square and deep midwicket
slower yorker, full and wide. Looks like it landed just past the wide marker, but after it had passed the batsman. he let that go
offcutter at a length on leg, clipped aerially towards deep square
slower ball, short and just outside off. Cut to sweeper cover
full and just outside off, drilled along the floor to long-on
short of a length offcutter, into off stump. Opens the face and runs it to third man

past the inside edge. Bumrah thinks there might have been an inside edge it appears. No reviews left of course. But that was past him it appears. A climbing offbreak from outside off, he was looking to jab into the covers. Ultra Edge shows it clipped the top of the knee flap
slower ball at a length outside off, jabbed into the covers
beaten on the slog. Slower ball, full and outside off. Through his shot well before that arrives
length at off stump, punched off the back foot to long-off
short of a length at leg stump, nudged through square leg off the back foot
launched over deep midwicket off the back foot this time! Shankar has picked his bowler, and the bowler's erred. Dropped short, just outside off, sitting up nicely and a confident aerial pull
pummeled over deep midwicket. Nice bat speed on this. At a length and on middle stump. Gets down on one knee and keeps the front foot out of the way for the slog sweep, sweetly timed
spanked over the bowler but Pollard dives to the right at long-off and parries it to long-on. Short of a length and pushed through in the corridor, lofted punch over the bowler
pushed through quickly at a length, on off stump. Punched back to the bowler
short of a length and turning away outside off, defended off the back foot

taken at deep backward square! Oh boy, the wheels are coming right off. Chahar is doing the job for Mumbai again. Length ball at middle stump, brings out the slog sweep and gets no power on it. Milne stretches two hands to his right and ends up grabbing it with only one - ball caught hand, as they say, but he'd done the work to get under that

dropped at short fine! Rohit Sharma's a bit casual under this. Googly at a length on middle stump, looks for the sweep and gets a top edge. Rohit is slow to try and get under that as it sails over him. In the end he's stretching backwards and blind to grab it. Gets a hand on it but not close to grabbing it
legbreak at a length on leg stump, flicked to short fine
good length and rising as it beats the flick and hits the pads in front of middle

lofted it straight to long-off! He's lost his shape. It's a googly, short of a length outside off. Shapes to blaze that through cover off the back foot, but he's going too hard as that stick in the pitch and it's a lofted cut straight to the fielder
short of a length just outside off, stabbed to third man off the back foot
full slower ball outside off, splits the legs and drives to sweeper cover
slower short ball at the body, through his pull too early. Deflected off the body to third man's left
short of a length just outside off, late cut to backward point's right
length and into leg stump, makes room and has a flap at that in front of the body. Inside edge down to fine leg
yorker length at leg stump, jammed into the leg side
short of a length at leg stump, lap sweep to deep backward square's right
good length legreak outside off, defended off the back foot
length and just outside off, opens the face and runs it to short third's right
length and turning away outside off, punched to long-off off the back foot
length at off stump, holds its line and takes the leading edge as he shapes to flick
length at middle stump, jabs at it with hard hands, thick inside edge to short fine
slower ball, short of a length and kicking up into the handle as he looks to run this to third man
length ball sliding onto the pads, flicked with the angle to short fine
slower ball, short of a length at the body. Clipped through square leg

oh they might have Warner run-out here! Yup, by a long way. It's a slower ball, dropped in front of point with soft hands. Calls for a run that is not there. Hardik is quick onto the ball and tears the stumps down at the striker's end. Is this the beginning of a collapse?
top edge over the keeper. Steps out at this short offcutter and looks to swing it into the leg side. Rewarded for his intent
slower ball at a length on middle stump, jabbed to deep midwicket with the angle
short of a length and cutting into the body as he gets deep in the crease. Rolls to short third's right and Virat calls for the single
length ball slides on low at leg stump. Whipped to long leg's right
length at leg stump, swept to long leg
nearly chops on. Short of a length and rising into the body as he shapes to play the late cut. Proprely cramped, gets it onto his front pad off the inside edge
short of a length and turning into the stumps, opens the face and steers to short third
dismissed over deep midwicket! Brutally struck. Full and just outside off, perfect slot for the slog sweep and he's onto that so quickly. Low and powerful
offcutter at a length outside off, drives on the up and gets a thick outside edge to short third
slower ball at a length on middle stump, clipped through midwicket off the back foot
slower ball at a length outside off, nice flowing drive on the rise to sweeper cover
full offcutter at middle stump, driven to long-off
short of a length outside off, cut straight to point
slower ball at a length outside off, chopped into the turf off the under-edge

drills it straight to long-off! This is probably criticism from the last game playing on this mind. Chahar gets him the way he got Gill the other night - with a dipping length ball that just drifts in towards the body, late in its trajectory. Messes with the flow for the straight six, suddenly there's no room and he can only dig it out to the safest hands on the pitch
good length and turning away from off. Watches it closely and follows with his hands to defend
legbreak at leg stump, leans in and flicks to deep square
good length and ripping down leg side, past the attempted flick
just past leg stump. Gets low into the off side for the ramp and that rips past the bat from outside off
short of a length legbreak turning away from off, pulled to long-on
legbreak dropped short, turning away outside off. Pulled straight to midwicket
short of a length at off stump, punched to extra cover off the back foot
length at middle stump, steps out and shovels towards long-on
length at middle stump, defended down the pitch
length at off stump, defended into the covers off the front foot

he's stepped onto his stumps! Oh boy, what a way to go when you're striking them this well. He wants to ramp him fine, so he gets hurriedly into the crease at this length ball at middle stump. His back leg has landed onto the base of the stumps and that is the end of a whirlwind inningds
short of a length and wide outside off, mistimed cut to extra cover
slower ball at a length outside off, chopped to sweeper cover
nearly run-out here is Warner. Short of a length at off stump, defended to Hardik's left at backward point. He runs in and would have had him at the non-striker's end with a direct hit
pumped over midwicket! That is one sweeet connection. He's dragged it short with an angle into Warner, who clears the front foot and watches this closely for the pull
legcutter, short of a length at off stump. Pulled to deep square with a swivel
short of a length just outside off, chopped to third man
short of a length outside off, chopped into the covers, searching for room
low full toss at off stump, punched to extra cover from the crease
slower ball at a length outside off, steered to short third with an open face
short of a length slower ball at off stump, hard-handed jab towards mid-off and a risky single
slower ball, short of a length and just outside off. Opens the face and steers into the off side
slower ball at a length on middle stump, turned into the leg side off the back foot

just past midwicket running backwards and well short of long-on. Slower ball at a length outside off, Bairstow is looking for the booming drive but is deceived completely. Ends up jabbing it high into the leg side

Boult scrambles to his right like he's lost control on a treadmill. This teases him and trickles into the boundary. A full toss, mistimed drive to mid-off's right. Boult takes a tumble and turns it into a slide, but the ball is long gone
length at middle stump, swept straight to short fine
oh superb from Pollard at long-on. Short ball at middle stump, pulled firmly from deep in the crease. Pollard sprints and stretches full length to his left to stop that
short of a length outside off and sliding on, mistimed pull to deep midwicket off the inside half

leans in and crunches it over wide long-on. He's making this ridiculously easy right now. It's full and drifted into leg stump, with some pace on it. Sets him up perfectly for the slog and it flies off the bat
short outside off, pulled straight to mid-on

mix-up but quite safe in the end. Slower short ball hooked vicously on the bounce to deep square's right. Hardik Pandya takes a tumble and recovers after stopping that. Warner is sent back quickly as he turns for the seocnd
slower bouncer, cuts down leg side and he lets it go after shaping to hook
lofted over mid-on with confidence. Length ball in at middle and leg, front leg in the leg side to create room and holds his shape as he uses the pace of this to go over the infield
top edge and splits them in the SRH dugout! Short of a length ball just outside off, instinctive front foot pull ends up a top edge. And it is over short fine and over the line
short of a length at off stump, hurriedly chopped into the covers
slower short ball across the corridor. Warner is on his backside as he tries to jump into line and ramp this fine. Sails past his pace
welcomed with a drill over mid-off. Slower ball at a length in the corridor, clears the front leg and flat-bats that
length and tight at off stump, stabbed towards backward point off the back foot
short of a length and keeping low in the corridor, beaten on the pull as that keeps low
misses on the yorker, it ends up a full toss outside off and he punches that gratefully to mid-off's left
lofted over mid-off! It's a slower ball in the slot, but it doesn't matter to YJB. Gets out to the pitch of that and extends his arms to send this on its way
goes a littler finer this time as deep square had been put in. Length at the leg stump, half a stride down again and swings from in front of the body, closes the face a lot more this time
swung into the square leg boundary. Short of a length and curved into the body, gets a half stride out and gets this aerially but safely past the leg umpire
yorker outside off. Springs into that looking to drive, can only jam it meekly into the covers
length at middle stump, punched to mid-on from the crease
slower ball squares him up from a leg stump line. He defends it pitch side on the off side with soft hands
yorker at middle stump, gets the front leg away and jams that to mid-off
short of a length and into the pads, clipped to deep square off the back foot

big appeal for catch behind is turned down. Mumbai have reviewed it. That is a sharp ball, short of a length and climbing into the body of YJB who is cut in half trying to play the initial line. There was a sound before it went through to the keeper - who has made a sensational diving catch to his left - but it looks like that wasn't anywhere near the bat. It clipped the knee flap of the back leg. And it is not out on lbw, that is missing the stumps. Mumbai lose the review
short of a length just outside off, mistimed chop into the covers. Easy run taken and then Rohit decides to throw at the strikers end. They get an overthrow at fine leg
short of a length and jagging in off the surface, cramps him on the cut and he's forced to drop that into the off side
short of a length and swung away just outside off, punched into the covers off the back foot
length and swung away outside off, left alone
short of a length at off stump, punched into the covers
lbw appeal turned down as he's pinned on the back foot trying to flick. That was probably sliding down
